title: After Asean hosting, Marcos sets sights on Apec in China

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fresh from wrapping up the Philippine hosting of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits, President Marcos is set to fly to Shenzhen, China, for the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting on Nov. 18 to 19. Marcos and the Philippine delegation will leave the country on Wednesday afternoon, immediately
